notes: Probabilities are stored at full precision; a letter probability of exactly 0 means the letter was not among the 20 returned tokens (see *_top20_floor).
The base and rerun requests differ only in the API's user field.
The cache key is a hash of kind, deployment name and request body; it does not include the endpoint or API version, which are recorded here instead.
HotpotQA F1 follows the official evaluator's yes/no/noanswer rule.
response_models counts responses as read during this run: a cached request used twice counts twice, so the totals exceed the number of distinct requests.
